speaker: VOICE
text: You recovered the sequence. There's one memory left, Arin.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: That voice... Mira? You've been guiding me?

speaker: MIRA [MEMORY]
text: I'm not really here, Arin. I'm the memory of Mira that you buried.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: You stayed behind to shut the Core down. I left you there.

speaker: MIRA [MEMORY]
text: I stayed to trigger the shutdown. It was interrupted before the Core could be isolated. I never made it out.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: Even after I survived, my mind buried the truth.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: VESPER ALERT: CORE CONTAINMENT FAILING. AUTOMATIC RESTART IMMINENT.

speaker: ARIN [YOU]
text: The shutdown procedure is recovered. I can transmit it to the team.

speaker: MIRA [MEMORY]
text: Then let the truth leave this place with you.
